story.text: Next the wolf took the pig to pick {APPLES}. The pig {THREW} one far away, and ran home while the wolf chased it. Then they met at the {FAIR}. The pig hid in a butter {CHURN}, and it rolled down the {HILL}, right at the wolf. He was so {SCARED} that he ran all the way home!
story.caption: So he got into the churn to hide
